data.notes: Purple: people. Grafana authenticates its own native local accounts. External IdP integration is deferred.

Amber: the only UI. Host port 3000. Shared analyst/auditor ClickHouse datasource credentials (svc_grafana_analyst, svc_grafana_auditor). Dashboards, Log Search over siem.log_search, SQL Explore and pipeline health alerts.

Blue: data. ClickHouse 26.8.34.13 LTS. Host 8123/9000 bind to loopback; applications use internal service connectivity. Query log records the shared database service identities (svc_vector, svc_grafana_analyst, svc_grafana_auditor), not individual Grafana users.

Blue: data. Logical table audit.query_archive INSIDE ClickHouse, not a separate server. Incremental materialized view from system.query_log; two-year TTL. Not a claim of immutable external storage or complete per-user audit attribution.
